versions.changelog:
Initial release of Work Productivity Nano Pdf Workflow Helper.

- Provides practical support for Nano Pdf-style workflows, focusing on bug fixing, reliability, setup hardening, and adjacent skills.
- Delivers concise work plans, templates, automation outlines, or decision aids tailored for immediate user needs.
- Uses local-hardware-friendly approaches, such as scripts, checklists, and small-model workflows.
- Includes built-in triggers for related keywords and sample requests.
- Outputs are validated against clear criteria and include a verification note.

- Initial release of the Work Productivity Nano PDF Workflow Helper skill.
- Provides step-by-step guidance for creating, improving, and validating Nano PDF-style productivity workflows.
- Designed for users needing practical support with editing, bug fixing, hardening, and reliability of PDF workflows.
- Outputs include tailored artifacts, reusable checklists, and implementation notes suitable for local hardware environments.
- Automatically requests missing information only when necessary, streamlining user experience.
